text: Hydro-CPS-Sim 文档 面向供水网络信息物理系统安全研究的联合仿真平台。 Hydro-CPS-Sim 将水力过程、PLC 控制、SCADA 通信与网络仿真连接起来，为网络攻击评估、跨层影响分析和防御研究提供可扩展的实验环境。 源代码： WandeF/hydro-cps-sim 项目概览 跨层联合仿真 ：连接水力模型、控制逻辑和通信过程，观察网络层事件如何影响物理水网。 攻击影响评估 ：为 MITM、DoS 与 PLC 逻辑篡改等研究场景提供实验与分析框架；实际可执行场景以源码和配置为准。 可复现实验流程 ：以配置文件组织仿真，通过脚本启动多组件闭环，并导出运行日志与 CSV 结果。 面向研究扩展 ：围绕控制、网络和物理层扩展实验设置，用于研究攻击传播、异常检测及防御策略。 平台关注一个核心问题： 网络攻击如何通过数据采集、控制决策和执行过程，逐步传播到物理水力系统？ 典型研究链路：攻击与扰动 → 网络通信（ns-3 / Namespace）→ SCADA / PLC → 水力计算（DHALSIM-epynet）→ 日志与 CSV 分析。 平台与研究方法 查看 系统架构与闭环流程 、 C-Town 控制依赖 以及 三类攻击的跨层传播与证据组织 ，了解平台如何连接网络、控制与水力过程。 文档目录 项目概览 项目简介 系统架构 使用指南 安装与环境 快速开始 实验与配置 攻防实验 配置说明 社区与研究 论文与引用 贡献与反馈

text: 项目简介 Hydro-CPS-Sim 是一个围绕**供水系统（Water Distribution Systems）**构建的 CPS 安全联合仿真研究平台，主要服务于工业网络攻击影响分析、攻击路径研究和防御方法验证。 研究动机 传统水力模拟工具擅长计算流量、压力、水箱水位等物理变量，但难以独立体现真实控制和通信过程；网络仿真工具能够刻画时延、丢包和拓扑，却往往缺少真实水力反馈。将两者在闭环中整合，可以分析攻击是否、何时以及如何影响物理系统。 项目组件 组件 在研究平台中的作用 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 水网水力计算及物理状态更新 OpenPLC PLC 程序执行与控制逻辑 ns-3 通信网络建模与仿真 Linux Network Namespace 将主机网络过程映射到隔离网络环境 Python 协调与分析模块 配置读取、组件编排、状态交互和实验结果导出 典型研究问题 攻击导致的数据篡改，在哪个控制轮次改变 PLC 决策？ 丢包或通信超时是否必然引起泵阀控制偏离？ 相同的物理异常，是否可能来自不同的网络和逻辑原因？ 如何将网络日志、控制轨迹和水力变量关联起来进行因果分析？ 当前边界 该项目旨在科研仿真和方法验证，不是现实供水设施的运维控制软件。不同攻击场景的可用性、参数名称和示例数据需与对应提交版本核对。任何未经过验证的实验结果不应作为真实供水系统风险的直接量化结论。 源代码： https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim 研究目标与分析方法 项目围绕四个问题组织跨层实验：攻击如何进入控制输入或控制规则；不同入口如何形成不同传播路径；通信退化在什么条件下转化为控制偏离；如何用分层观测与基线对照解释物理后果。 实验通过指定的协议、网络或控制入口施加干预，保持水力反馈正常运行，并同时记录中间状态。分析既关注异常最早出现在哪一层，也关注传播在哪一层停止，而非预先假定网络攻击一定造成物理偏差。 C-Town 示例与控制依赖 C-Town 水网拓扑、控制分区与跨区数据依赖。图中攻击入口对应跨层分析场景，其他预设的目标和参数参见 攻防实验 。 PLC间的逻辑关系 数据来源 经 SCADA 转发后的控制用途 PLC2 的 T1 PLC1 对 PU1、PU2 的控制 PLC3 的 T2、T3 本地 V2 与 PU4、PU5 的控制 PLC6 的 T5 PLC4 对 PU8 的控制 PLC8 的 T7 PLC4 对 PU10、PU11 的控制 PLC7 的 T4 PLC5 对 PU6、PU7 的控制 PLC4 的本地 T6 主要用于监测。上述分区表示逻辑管理关系，并不意味着所有关联传感器都安装在同一机柜。跨区依赖使数据完整性和新鲜度能够影响另一控制区域的泵阀判断。 更多内容参见 系统架构 和 攻防实验 。

title: 系统架构
description: 系统架构 Hydro-CPS-Sim 将水力求解、可执行 PLC 程序、工业协议与网络路径连接为闭环。攻击从协议、网络或控制入口介入，再经控制判断和执行器反馈影响水力状态。 平台总体架构 平台总体架构：场景配置、联合仿真编排与各运行模块。 模块 实现与职责 场景配置 YAML 描述水网、P
text: 系统架构 Hydro-CPS-Sim 将水力求解、可执行 PLC 程序、工业协议与网络路径连接为闭环。攻击从协议、网络或控制入口介入，再经控制判断和执行器反馈影响水力状态。 平台总体架构 平台总体架构：场景配置、联合仿真编排与各运行模块。 模块 实现与职责 场景配置 YAML 描述水网、PLC/SCADA 映射、控制规则、网络、攻击与运行参数 联合仿真编排 生成 ST 程序、编译 PLC、生成网络环境、启动进程并导出结果 物理过程 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 推进水力状态，接收泵阀动作 控制与监控 OpenPLC 执行控制逻辑；PLC Adapter 衔接输入输出；SCADA 通过 Modbus TCP 采集与转发数据 网络通信 Linux network namespace 提供独立网络身份，经 TAP/veth 接入 ns-3 攻击执行 在配置的协议、网络或控制入口执行 MITM、DoS 或逻辑注入 同步 通过文件系统标志协调多进程，按实验轮次交换状态 数据记录 汇集攻击、通信、控制、执行器与水力记录，供基线对照使用 闭环运行流程 闭环运行流程：场景生成、数据采集、控制执行与水力反馈。 环境生成 ：读取水网和 YAML 配置，生成控制程序、地址映射、ns-3 拓扑与命名空间配置。 初始化 ：启动 OpenPLC、SCADA 与网络进程，准备物理状态和同步目录。 采集与转发 ：水力模块提供当前传感器状态，SCADA 通过 Modbus TCP 采集数据并转发跨 PLC 控制依赖。 控制执行 ：OpenPLC 根据当前输入和有效规则生成泵阀命令。 水力反馈 ：执行器状态进入下一步水力求解，产生新的水位、压力和流量。 记录与对照 ：保存该轮数据，推进下一轮，并在运行后与同条件基线对齐。 独立网络节点与协议交互 每个 PLC、SCADA 和攻击节点运行在各自的 Linux network namespace 中，拥有独立接口和协议栈。ns-3 为这些端点提供可配置的链路、路由与网络动态。正常 Modbus 通信和攻击流量通过配置的网络路径交互。 这种部署保留了 PLC 程序执行、寄存器/线圈映射、协议请求与响应、超时及数据保持等中间环节。它使研究者能够观察通信异常是否改变控制输入，以及输入变化是否真正触发执行器动作。 代码入口 scripts/run_all.sh ：环境准备、运行和清理的总入口。 src/control/ ：ST 程序生成、编译与 OpenPLC 启动。 src/network/ ：命名空间与 ns-3 拓扑生成。 src/runtime/ 、 src/sync/ ：闭环协调与同步。 src/scada/ 、 src/plc/ 、 src/comm/ ：数据采集、适配与 Modbus 交互。 src/attack/ ：攻击启动与执行。 src/io/ ：水力接口与结果导出。 使用方法参见 快速开始 ，运行参数参见 配置说明 。

title: 安装与环境
description: 安装与环境 使用 install.sh 安装 Hydro-CPS-Sim 及其依赖。安装过程会配置系统软件包、Conda 环境、OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3 和 DHALSIM-epynet。 支持的环境 项目 要求 操作系统 Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04，x86_6
text: 安装与环境 使用 install.sh 安装 Hydro-CPS-Sim 及其依赖。安装过程会配置系统软件包、Conda 环境、OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3 和 DHALSIM-epynet。 支持的环境 项目 要求 操作系统 Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04，x86_64 Python 3.10（安装脚本创建的 Conda 环境） 环境管理 Conda 系统权限 安装和网络配置环节需要 sudo 网络连接 安装依赖及克隆所需仓库 主体依赖 OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3、DHALSIM-epynet 安装包含 OpenPLC 命令行运行时，不包含 Web 管理服务。 获取源码 git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim 预检查 查看安装计划，不修改系统： bash install.sh --dry-run 正式安装 确认环境及权限后再运行： bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps 安装过程中可能需要较长时间编译 OpenPLC 和 ns-3。默认环境名为 hydro-cps ；脚本也支持 --env 、 --jobs 、 --parent 等参数，详见 bash install.sh --help 。 安装完成后的自检 安装脚本末尾包含基础测试过程；如需再次运行仓库中的 Python 单元测试： python -m unittest discover -s tests 安装程序会执行 EPANET 动态库加载检查和 Python 单元测试。安装完成后，继续 快速开始 运行 C-Town 示例。 安装脚本会更新所有 C-Town 示例 YAML 的五个顶层路径键，并将修改前的文件保存到 output/install-backups/ 。迁移机器后需重新检查路径；不要直接沿用源码中的开发者绝对路径。

title: 快速开始
description: 快速开始 安装完成后，使用 C-Town 示例运行第一个闭环仿真实验。 每次运行会清理配置输出目录中的 runtime/ 、 reports/ 、 st/ 和 plcs/ 。开始另一个实验前，请将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录。使用普通用户启动，脚本会按需请求 sudo。 运行一个示例 cd
text: 快速开始 安装完成后，使用 C-Town 示例运行第一个闭环仿真实验。 每次运行会清理配置输出目录中的 runtime/ 、 reports/ 、 st/ 和 plcs/ 。开始另一个实验前，请将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录。使用普通用户启动，脚本会按需请求 sudo。 运行一个示例 cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 如果希望先缩短实验轮数，可以使用运行器的 --iterations 参数，例如： bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 此命令将仿真缩短为 10 轮，适合检查启动与结果导出流程。 自定义配置入口 bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml 运行器的可选参数包括： 参数 用途 --config PATH 指定 YAML 配置文件 --iterations N 覆盖仿真轮数 --logic-wait SECONDS SCADA 下发后、读取 PLC 输出前的等待间隔 --poll-interval SECONDS 文件标志轮询间隔 --scada-modbus-workers N SCADA Modbus 并行工作线程数 具体帮助信息可由 bash scripts/run_all.sh --help 查询。 查看输出 实验结果导出到 output_path 指定目录下的 reports/csv ，日志与阶段耗时分别保存在 logs/ 和 timing/ 中。 运行结束后，终端还会打印类似下面的提示： [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv 真实路径取决于配置文件中的 output_path ，请勿直接复制上面的占位符作为命令。 下一步 请参考 攻防实验 了解如何组织基线与攻击条件对照，通过 配置说明 调整场景参数。

title: 攻防实验
description: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 的研究重点之一，是沿着 网络事件 → 数据状态 → 控制决策 → 水力响应 的链路分析攻击传播机制。 研究场景 攻击类型 网络或控制层变化 重点观测 MITM（中间人攻击） 通信内容可能遭到修改 输入数据与真实物理状态的偏差、决策变化 DoS（拒绝服务
text: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 的研究重点之一，是沿着 网络事件 → 数据状态 → 控制决策 → 水力响应 的链路分析攻击传播机制。 研究场景 攻击类型 网络或控制层变化 重点观测 MITM（中间人攻击） 通信内容可能遭到修改 输入数据与真实物理状态的偏差、决策变化 DoS（拒绝服务） 通信延迟、丢包或超时 数据新鲜度、缓存使用、控制时机 PLC 逻辑篡改 控制规则可能发生变化 PLC 逻辑、执行器输出、物理轨迹 三类入口与传播机制 三类攻击的跨层传播路径。箭头表示可能的通路；后续影响取决于通信状态、控制条件和水力反馈。 MITM：输入内容改变。 跨层分析场景修改 SCADA 下发至 PLC4 的 T7 数据，偏移后的输入可能提前越过 PU10 的关泵阈值。是否产生动作变化，还取决于当前状态与控制规则。 DoS：输入新鲜度下降。 跨层分析场景在 PLC7 的采集路径引入拥塞；超时后 SCADA 可能保持旧 T4，再将旧值转发给 PLC5。只有关键判断轮次的输入差异改变控制条件，才会进一步影响 PU6/PU7 和水力反馈。 逻辑注入：有效规则改变。 修改 PLC4 中 PU10 的 T7 关闭阈值，模拟已获得程序修改能力的情况。修改发生与首次控制偏离可能相隔多个轮次，需要等待过程状态触发新规则。 同一输入可能供多个控制规则使用，改写输入与仅改写某条阈值规则的后续效果可能不同。比较时应关注首次偏离、状态保持、重新开启和其他依赖该输入的执行器。 场景设置与配置选择 跨层分析场景运行 80 轮，攻击窗口为第 15–55 轮，DoS 目标为 PLC7 的采集路径。下表中的示例配置采用各自的目标与窗口：例如 DoS 预设指向 PLC2，攻击窗口为第 5–90 轮。运行前应选择所需场景，检查目标、轮数和控制依赖。 复现实验时，应使用同一版本的源码、完整 YAML、水网输入、控制映射和基线数据。历史字段 PLC9_T7 需映射到相应配置中的 T7 采集端，不能仅凭文件名判断目标。 示例配置 下表列出 版本 2406aa6 的示例配置，窗口单位为控制轮次。 配置文件 目标或用途 攻击轮次 config.yaml 无攻击基线 / Baseline — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 下发 / Downlink 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 T7 响应 / Response 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2 · 单源 / Single source 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2 · 三源 / Three sources 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml PLC4 · PU10 T7 阈值 / Threshold 20–90 部分 MITM 文件名保留了 PLC7/PLC9 的历史编号，对应配置内的目标为 PLC6/PLC8。选择场景时，以 YAML 中的目标、变量映射和触发窗口为准。 安装完成后，指定配置启动实验： bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 先运行基线并保存结果，再运行攻击配置。导出目录 reports/csv/ 包含 physics.csv 、 actuator_state.csv 、 scada_observed_long.csv 、 scada_observed_wide.csv 、 scada_observed_key.csv 、 attack_schedule.csv 、 attack_events.csv 、 scada_timeout_events.csv 和 cycle_timing.csv 。攻击事件或超时记录并不等于已经产生物理偏离，需要与基线对齐分析。 推荐的对照流程 固定水网、PLC 逻辑、仿真时长和必要的随机性设置。 运行无攻击基线（baseline），保存每轮 CSV 与日志。 仅改变准备考察的攻击变量，运行对照实验。 对齐网络、PLC 和水力时间记录，分析关键轮次。 汇总重复实验结果，而不仅是展示单次运行曲线。 跨层分析不应只看最终水位 同样的水箱水位偏差，可能来自错误传感数据、通信超时导致的陈旧数据，或者 PLC 控制规则改变。因此需要同时收集上游证据。对于 DoS，发生通信超时并不保证会导致控制偏离，实际传播还取决于控制所需数据是否及时更新。 如何组织跨层证据 建议同时记录四类首次事件：攻击首次生效 t_A 、通信首次异常 t_C 、执行器首次偏离基线 t_U 、物理变量首次越过预设偏差阈值 t_P 。逻辑注入不一定存在通信异常阶段， t_C 可记为不适用；窗口内未出现的事件应记为“未观察到”，不能补成末轮。 观测层 建议证据 解释时需要区分 攻击 调度记录、修改帧与注入规则 配置的时间窗口与实际生效事件 通信与输入 超时、成功读取、SCADA 保持值与下发记录 通信失败、旧值保持与控制器实际收到的输入 控制 有效阈值、上一轮状态与泵阀输出 相对基线不同的动作、依据真实输入的名义动作及依据已下发输入应有的动作 物理 水位、压力、流量、实际 sim_time 按轮次对齐与按相同引擎时刻对齐的偏差 离散控制可报告“不同于基线的执行器状态数 / 可比较状态总数”。水位、压力等连续量可报告 RMSE、平均绝对偏差和最大绝对偏差；每项指标应给出变量范围、观察窗口、单位、缺失处理及分母。通信 RTT 应说明是否只统计成功请求，重复运行应说明随机种子与聚合口径。 时间对齐限制： 水力引擎的内部事件步可能使同一轮次对应不同物理时刻。按轮次计算的峰值不能直接解释为严格同时刻的净攻击效应；必要时在实际引擎时间的共同观测点重新比较，并报告匹配样本数。墙钟通信频率也不等于 PLC 扫描频率。 规模实验边界： PLC 规模测试独立于 C-Town 攻击实验，不包含水力计算。通信与控制吞吐不能直接当作完整水网闭环的运行性能。 保存与复现实验 每次运行保存源码版本、完整配置、输入模型、启动命令、随机种子与结果目录。攻击运行应与相同初始状态和网络条件下的基线配对。汇总多次运行时，说明种子是否独立、指标如何聚合，以及失败或缺失记录的处理方式。

text: 配置说明 Hydro-CPS-Sim 使用 YAML 配置文件组织实验场景，默认配置为 examples/c_town/config.yaml 。 配置文件在运行中的作用 指定水网模型及其输入文件。 指向 OpenPLC、ns-3 等组件所在目录。 指定输出目录及仿真轮数。 保存水网控制、网络及实验设置。 安装程序会更新示例配置中的五个顶层路径字段： 路径键 用途 root_path 第三方依赖工作目录 openplc_path OpenPLC 源码或构建目录 ns3_path ns-3 源码或构建目录 inp_file EPANET 水网输入文件 output_path 实验结果输出目录 迁移环境或更换模型时，请更新这些路径，并确保 output_path 指向专用的实验输出目录。 建议工作方式 不要直接修改唯一的基准配置；可以复制已验证的 config.yaml ，然后在副本中改变实验参数。每次实验应记录所用源码提交、配置文件、启动命令与日志位置。 配置之间的约束 PLC 的传感器与执行器名称须与水网模型一致，跨 PLC 控制依赖须能通过 SCADA 转发。网络端点、命名空间和攻击目标应使用一致的标识。复制场景后，需同时检查模型、控制映射和网络拓扑。 仿真与控制参数 字段 当前基线值或作用 iterations 100；可由运行命令覆盖 noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET 总时长 86400 秒、水力步长 300 秒 physics inp_controls: strip 、 step_order: next-run 、 init_flag: 0 plcs PLC1–PLC8 的传感器、执行器与控制规则 network ns-3 后端、实时调度、路由、节点、链路、LAN 和 TAP attacks.enabled 攻击配置的总开关 attacks.scenarios 场景类型、触发器、目标和类型特有参数 攻击场景类型包括 modbus_mitm 、 udp_dos 、 openplc_logic_injection 。 trigger.type: iteration_window 使用 start_iteration / end_iteration ；场景还需对应的攻击节点、拦截规则或逻辑注入设置，不应仅向基线追加一个开关。参见 攻防实验 中的实际配置。

title: Home
description: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics
text: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics, PLC control, SCADA communications, and network simulation to support attack-impact evaluation, cross-layer analysis, and defense research. Source code: WandeF/hydro-cps-sim Overview Cross-layer co-simulation : Link hydraulic models, control logic, and communication processes to study how cyber events affect the physical network. Attack-impact evaluation : Support research into MITM, DoS, and PLC logic modification scenarios. Runnable cases depend on the published code and configurations. Reproducible workflows : Organize experiments through configuration files and scripts, and export logs and CSV results for analysis. Research extensibility : Investigate control, network, and hydraulic effects within a modular experiment framework. The key research question is: How do cyberattacks propagate through sensing, control decisions, and actuation into physical water-system behavior? A typical research path: attacks and disturbances → network communication (ns-3 / Namespace) → SCADA / PLC → hydraulics (DHALSIM-epynet) → log and CSV analysis. Platform and research method Explore the architecture and closed-loop workflow , C-Town control dependencies , and attack propagation and evidence organization to understand how network, control and hydraulics interact. Documentation Overview Introduction Architecture Get Started Installation Quick Start Experiments & Configuration Security Experiments Configuration Research & Community Publications & Citation Contributing & Feedback

title: Introduction
description: Introduction Hydro-CPS-Sim is a research co-simulation platform for water distribution cyber-physical systems . It is designed for security exper
text: Introduction Hydro-CPS-Sim is a research co-simulation platform for water distribution cyber-physical systems . It is designed for security experimentation, cross-layer impact assessment, and defense-method evaluation. Motivation Hydraulic simulators capture the evolution of pressures, flows, and tank levels, while network simulators characterize topology, delays, and packet loss. Studying cyber-physical incidents requires combining both aspects with an actual control loop. Main components Component Role DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET Hydraulic simulation and physical-state updates OpenPLC PLC control-program execution ns-3 Communication-network simulation Linux Network Namespace Isolated Linux network environments Python orchestration modules Configuration, process coordination, state exchange, and output Example research questions At what control iteration does manipulated input data change a PLC decision? Does packet loss or timeout necessarily cause an actuator deviation? Can similar physical anomalies arise from different cyber or control causes? How can network traces, controller behavior, and physical trajectories be aligned? Scope This is a research simulation tool, not software for operating a real water utility. Availability of specific attack configurations and parameter names must be checked against the corresponding repository version. Simulation results should not be interpreted directly as quantitative risk assessments for production systems. Repository: https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim Research goals and method The project asks four connected questions: how attacks enter control inputs or rules; how different entry points create distinct propagation paths; when communication degradation becomes control deviation; and how layered observations and baseline comparisons explain physical consequences. Experiments intervene at designated protocol, network or control interfaces while retaining hydraulic feedback and recording intermediate states. Analysis examines both where anomalies first appear and where propagation stops, without assuming that every cyberattack must cause a physical deviation. C-Town example and control dependencies C-Town network, control regions and cross-region dependencies. Attack annotations show the cross-layer analysis scenarios; see Experiments for other presets and parameters. Logical relationships between PLCs Measurement source Control dependency forwarded through SCADA T1 at PLC2 PU1 and PU2 at PLC1 T2 and T3 at PLC3 Local V2, PU4 and PU5 T5 at PLC6 PU8 at PLC4 T7 at PLC8 PU10 and PU11 at PLC4 T4 at PLC7 PU6 and PU7 at PLC5 Local T6 at PLC4 is primarily monitored. Regions represent logical ownership, not necessarily a shared physical cabinet. Cross-region dependencies allow measurement integrity and freshness to influence actuator decisions in another region. See architecture and experiments .

title: Architecture
description: Architecture Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic simulation, executable PLC programs, industrial protocols and network paths in a closed loop. Attac
text: Architecture Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic simulation, executable PLC programs, industrial protocols and network paths in a closed loop. Attacks enter through a protocol, network or control interface and can affect hydraulics through controller decisions and actuator feedback. Platform architecture Platform architecture: scenario configuration, orchestration and runtime modules. Module Implementation and responsibility Scenario configuration YAML describes the water model, PLC/SCADA mappings, control rules, network, attacks and runtime settings Orchestration Generates ST programs, compiles PLCs, creates the network environment, starts processes and exports results Physical process DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET advances hydraulics using pump and valve states Control and supervision OpenPLC executes logic; PLC Adapters bridge I/O; SCADA acquires and forwards data over Modbus TCP Communication Linux network namespaces provide separate network identities connected to ns-3 through TAP/veth interfaces Attack execution Injects MITM, DoS or logic modifications at configured interfaces Synchronization Filesystem markers coordinate process state exchange by experiment iteration Logging Collects attack, communication, control, actuator and hydraulic records for baseline comparisons Closed-loop workflow Closed-loop workflow: scenario generation, data acquisition, control execution and hydraulic feedback. Generate the environment: Read the model and YAML, then generate control programs, address mappings, the ns-3 topology and namespace configuration. Initialize: Start OpenPLC, SCADA and network processes; prepare physical state and synchronization directories. Acquire and forward: Obtain current sensor state and use SCADA Modbus TCP exchanges to forward cross-PLC control dependencies. Execute control: OpenPLC evaluates current inputs and effective rules to produce pump and valve commands. Feed back: Apply actuator states to the next hydraulic step to obtain updated levels, pressures and flows. Record and compare: Save iteration evidence, advance the loop and compare completed runs with matching baselines. Independent endpoints and protocol exchanges Each PLC, SCADA and attack endpoint runs in a separate Linux network namespace with its own interfaces and protocol stack. ns-3 supplies configurable links, routing and network dynamics. Normal Modbus exchanges and attack traffic follow the configured network paths. This preserves intermediate behavior such as program execution, register/coil mappings, request/response exchanges, timeouts and held observations. Researchers can inspect whether communication anomalies change controller inputs and whether those inputs actually trigger actuator changes. Source entry points scripts/run_all.sh : preparation, execution and cleanup. src/control/ : ST generation, compilation and OpenPLC launch. src/network/ : namespace and ns-3 topology generation. src/runtime/ , src/sync/ : loop coordination and synchronization. src/scada/ , src/plc/ , src/comm/ : acquisition, adapters and Modbus exchanges. src/attack/ : attack launch and execution. src/io/ : hydraulic interfaces and result exports. See Quick Start for execution and Configuration for runtime settings.

title: Installation
description: Installation Use install.sh to install Hydro-CPS-Sim and its dependencies. The installer configures system packages, a Conda environment, the Ope
text: Installation Use install.sh to install Hydro-CPS-Sim and its dependencies. The installer configures system packages, a Conda environment, the OpenPLC command-line runtime, ns-3 and DHALSIM-epynet. Environment requirements Item Requirement Operating system Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04, x86_64 Python Python 3.10 in the Conda environment Environment manager Conda Privileges sudo is needed for installation and networking Internet Required for packages and source repositories Main dependencies OpenPLC command-line runtime, ns-3, DHALSIM-epynet Important: The installer builds the OpenPLC command-line runtime, not the full web management service. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim Preview installation steps bash install.sh --dry-run Install After checking the required privileges and system compatibility: bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps Building ns-3 and OpenPLC may take some time. The default environment is named hydro-cps ; see bash install.sh --help for --env , --jobs , and --parent options. Run the project test suite python -m unittest discover -s tests The installer checks EPANET shared-library loading and runs the Python test suite. After installation, follow Quick Start to run the C-Town example. The installer rewrites five top-level path keys in every C-Town YAML and saves changed originals under output/install-backups/ . Check paths after moving to a different machine; do not reuse developer-specific absolute paths from the source.

title: Quick Start
description: Quick Start After installation, run your first closed-loop simulation with the C-Town example. Each run clears runtime/ , reports/ , st/ , and pl
text: Quick Start After installation, run your first closed-loop simulation with the C-Town example. Each run clears runtime/ , reports/ , st/ , and plcs/ under the configured output directory. Copy results to a separate directory before the next experiment. Start as a normal user; the script requests sudo when needed. Run a simulation cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 You may override the configured number of iterations to try a shorter run: bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 This command limits the simulation to 10 iterations to check startup and result export. Select a configuration bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml Option Purpose --config PATH YAML configuration file --iterations N Number of iterations --logic-wait SECONDS Wait after SCADA downlink before reading control outputs --poll-interval SECONDS Marker polling interval --scada-modbus-workers N Concurrent SCADA Modbus workers Run bash scripts/run_all.sh --help for the definitive interface. Outputs Results are exported to reports/csv under output_path . Logs and stage timings are saved in logs/ and timing/ . At completion, the script prints: [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv The actual path comes from output_path in the configuration. The placeholder above is not a literal path. Continue with experiments and configuration .

title: Experiments
description: Security Experiments A core research goal is to trace how cyber events propagate through communication → information freshness/integrity → contro
text: Security Experiments A core research goal is to trace how cyber events propagate through communication → information freshness/integrity → controller decisions → hydraulic behavior . Research scenarios Scenario Primary disturbance Evidence of interest Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) Altered communication values Input corruption, PLC decisions, physical deviations Denial of Service (DoS) Delay, packet loss, or timeout Data freshness, cached values, control timing PLC logic manipulation Modified control rules Logic integrity, actuator outputs, physical trajectories Three entry points and propagation mechanisms Cross-layer attack propagation paths. Downstream effects depend on communication state, control conditions and hydraulic feedback. MITM changes input content. The cross-layer analysis scenario modifies T7 data sent from SCADA to PLC4. A biased input can cross the PU10 pump-off threshold earlier; actual action changes depend on process state and rules. DoS reduces input freshness. Congestion on the PLC7 acquisition path can cause timeouts, leaving SCADA to retain an older T4 observation and forward it to PLC5. Propagation to PU6/PU7 and hydraulics requires the stale input to change a relevant control decision. Logic injection changes effective rules. Modifying the T7 pump-off threshold for PU10 at PLC4 models an attacker with program modification capability. Injection and first control deviation need not coincide: process state must trigger the modified rule. An input may be shared by several rules. Changing that input and changing only one threshold can produce different subsequent behavior. Compare first deviation, state retention, reopening and other actuators consuming the same input. Scenario settings and configuration selection The cross-layer analysis scenarios run for 80 iterations with attacks active during iterations 15–55 and DoS targeting the PLC7 acquisition path. The example presets below have their own targets and windows: the DoS presets target PLC2 during iterations 5–90. Select the intended scenario and check its targets, run length and control dependencies before execution. For reproduction, use matching versions of the source, complete YAML, water model, control mapping and baseline data. Map historical fields such as PLC9_T7 to the T7 acquisition endpoint in the selected configuration; do not infer targets from filenames alone. Example configurations The table lists example configurations for revision 2406aa6 . Windows are measured in control iterations. Configuration Target or purpose Attack iterations config.yaml 无攻击基线 / Baseline — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 下发 / Downlink 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 T7 响应 / Response 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2 · 单源 / Single source 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2 · 三源 / Three sources 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml PLC4 · PU10 T7 阈值 / Threshold 20–90 Some MITM filenames retain historical PLC7/PLC9 identifiers, while their configurations target PLC6/PLC8. Select scenarios using the targets, variable mappings and trigger windows defined in YAML. After installation, select a configuration to start the experiment: bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 Run and preserve a baseline before the attack run. Exports under reports/csv/ include physics.csv , actuator_state.csv , scada_observed_long.csv , scada_observed_wide.csv , scada_observed_key.csv , attack_schedule.csv , attack_events.csv , scada_timeout_events.csv , and cycle_timing.csv . Attack events or timeouts alone do not establish physical deviation; compare aligned baseline evidence. Suggested methodology Fix hydraulic scenarios, control programs, time horizon, and random settings where applicable. Record attack-free baseline results including CSV files and runtime logs. Change only the attack variables under evaluation. Align network-level, control-level, and hydraulic observations. Analyze repeated runs, not just a single simulation trace. Why cross-layer evidence matters The same tank-level deviation could reflect false sensor values, a stale observation after a timeout, or an unauthorized PLC logic change. Evidence from upstream layers is essential for attribution. In a DoS scenario, communication failure alone does not guarantee a control deviation; propagation depends in part on whether fresh data is required at the relevant control iteration. Organizing cross-layer evidence Record four possible first events: attack activation t_A , communication anomaly t_C , actuator deviation from baseline t_U , and physical deviation crossing a predefined threshold t_P . Logic injection may have no communication-anomaly stage, making t_C inapplicable. Mark events absent from the observation window as unobserved rather than assigning them to the last iteration. Layer Suggested evidence Distinctions to preserve Attack Scheduling, modified frames and injected rules Configured window versus actual activation Communication and input Timeouts, successful reads, held SCADA values and downlink records Failed communication, stale values and inputs actually delivered to a controller Control Effective thresholds, previous state and actuator outputs Baseline mismatch, nominal decisions from true inputs and expected execution from delivered inputs Physical Levels, pressures, flows and actual sim_time Iteration-aligned versus equal-engine-time deviations For discrete control, report mismatched actuator states divided by comparable states. For continuous variables, consider RMSE, mean absolute deviation and peak absolute deviation. Define variables, windows, units, missing-data treatment and denominators. State whether RTT includes only successful requests and how repeated runs use seeds and aggregation. Time alignment: Internal hydraulic events can make the same iteration correspond to different physical times. An iteration-aligned peak is not automatically a simultaneous net attack effect. When needed, compare common actual engine-time observations and report the number of matches. Wall-clock communication update frequency is also distinct from PLC scan frequency. Scalability scope: PLC scalability tests are separate from C-Town attack experiments and exclude hydraulic computation. Communication and control throughput does not establish the performance of a full water-network loop. Saving and reproducing experiments Save the source revision, complete configuration, input model, invocation, random seeds and output directory for each run. Pair attack runs with baselines using matching initial states and network conditions. When aggregating repeated runs, state whether seeds are independent, how metrics are combined and how failed or missing records are handled.

title: Configuration
description: Configuration Hydro-CPS-Sim organizes experiments using YAML configuration files. The default is examples/c_town/config.yaml . What configuration
text: Configuration Hydro-CPS-Sim organizes experiments using YAML configuration files. The default is examples/c_town/config.yaml . What configuration controls Input hydraulic network files and simulation settings. External paths for OpenPLC and ns-3. Output directories and run length. Network, control, and experiment settings. The installer updates five top-level path fields in the example configurations: Key Purpose root_path Working directory for external dependencies openplc_path OpenPLC checkout or build directory ns3_path ns-3 checkout or build directory inp_file EPANET input file output_path Directory for generated results Update these paths when moving environments or replacing a model. Set output_path to a dedicated experiment output directory. Recommended practice Keep the original validated baseline configuration intact. Make copies for new experiments and record the git commit, exact YAML, invocation, and outputs for each run. Configuration constraints PLC sensor and actuator names must match the water model, and cross-PLC dependencies must be forwarded through SCADA. Use consistent identifiers for network endpoints, namespaces and attack targets. When copying a scenario, check its model, control mapping and network topology together. Simulation and control parameters Field Baseline value or role iterations 100; runner can override noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET duration 86400 seconds; hydraulic step 300 seconds physics inp_controls: strip , step_order: next-run , init_flag: 0 plcs Sensors, actuators and control rules for PLC1–PLC8 network ns-3 backend, realtime scheduling, routing, nodes, links, LANs and TAPs attacks.enabled Global switch in attack presets attacks.scenarios Scenario types, triggers, targets and type-specific options Attack types include modbus_mitm , udp_dos , and openplc_logic_injection . An iteration_window trigger uses start_iteration and end_iteration . Scenarios also need matching network endpoints, interception rules or logic injection settings; adding only a switch to the baseline is insufficient. See actual presets under experiments .

text: Contributing & Feedback Suggestions on functionality, installation, and reproducibility are welcome. A formal contribution policy and the open-source license will be established as the release plan is finalized. Reporting a problem Please use the project's GitHub Issues and include: OS and Python / Conda versions. Git commit and sanitized configuration files. Reproduction commands and relevant errors. Expected and actual results. Updating the website Documentation repository: WandeF/WandeF.github.io . Edit Markdown pages under content/zh/ and content/en/ , then run: python build.py Generated files are written to site/ . Preview locally with python -m http.server 8000 --directory site . Push to main in WandeF/WandeF.github.io to build and deploy automatically to https://wandef.github.io/ . Contribution areas Contributions can improve installation and configuration instructions, add reproducible examples, fix issues or refine translations. Describe the purpose, applicable version and validation of each change. Include configurations and run records with experimental data.
